name: Every Code
description: Community fork of the Codex CLI that adds browser control, multi-agent orchestration and automated drive and review modes.
whatItDoes: Every Code is a terminal coding agent for developers who like Codex but want more automation. It can coordinate several agents, drive a browser, keep working through a task unattended and review its own output.
howItWorks: The project tracks the upstream Rust codebase and layers extra features on top. It authenticates with an OpenAI key or a ChatGPT login, and external tool servers are configured in its own config file. It is launched from an npm package.

requirements.name: OPENAI_API_KEY
requirements.description: API key authentication; signing in with ChatGPT is the alternative

models: OpenAI models, plus other agent CLIs for multi-agent work
